page.metaDescription: Privacy information for the BCSentinel website, contact requests, and product use.
page.title: Privacy Policy
page.lead: Information about personal-data processing when using the website, contacting us, using partner features, completing payment, and using BCSentinel.
page.notice: This policy describes the currently intended production operation. A separate technical sprint will replace FormSubmit with a first-party contact endpoint and Brevo delivery; until then, the current use of FormSubmit is described transparently.

sections.title: 1. Controller
paragraphs:
Daniel Wauer

sections.title: 2. Scope and roles
paragraphs: Daniel Wauer acts as controller for website operation, contact requests, partner accounts, contract and payment administration, and BCSentinel's own operational and security data.

Where BCSentinel processes personal data from a customer's Business Central environment on behalf of that customer, the customer remains controller and Daniel Wauer acts as processor. A data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR will be concluded before production processing.

sections.title: 3. Hosting, backend, and server logs
paragraphs: The website, backend, and database are hosted with Hetzner Online GmbH on servers in Falkenstein, Germany.

When services are accessed, the IP address, timestamp, requested resource, referrer, browser and operating-system details, response status, and technical security or error data may be processed. This supports delivery, stability, abuse detection, and IT security. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR; the legitimate interest is secure and reliable operation.
Server and security logs are generally retained for no more than 14 days unless a security incident requires longer purpose-limited retention. A data processing agreement is concluded with Hetzner.

sections.title: 4. Local storage and technically necessary functions
paragraphs: The website uses local browser storage for language, light/dark appearance, and technically necessary session or authentication information. These items provide functions expressly requested by the user and are not used for advertising or cross-site tracking.
BCSentinel currently does not use advertising, reach-measurement, or profiling cookies. If non-essential technologies are introduced later, any required consent will be obtained before use.

sections.title: 5. Fonts
paragraphs: The website uses only locally available or system fonts. A page view does not send a font request to Google Fonts or another external font provider.

sections.title: 6. Contact form and email
paragraphs: When you contact us, we process your name, email address, company, topic, message, and technical submission data to handle the request.

The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR where the request relates to a contract or pre-contractual steps, and otherwise Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is the structured handling of business enquiries.

Until migration to the first-party BCSentinel contact endpoint, the form uses FormSubmit to forward messages to support@bcsentinel.com. FormSubmit therefore receives the submitted form data. Confidential information, passwords, complete API tokens, or special categories of personal data must not be sent through the form.

A first-party backend endpoint with server-side validation, spam protection, and email delivery through Brevo is planned. FormSubmit will be removed after migration and Brevo will then be documented as the email provider.
General contact enquiries are usually deleted no later than six months after completion unless a contractual relationship or statutory retention duty requires longer storage.

sections.title: 7. Partner accounts and authentication
paragraphs: For partner registration and portal use, we process contact, company, and profile data, partner code, referral attribution, commission and payout status, and authentication and security data.

Processing is required to perform the partner relationship under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR and to protect security under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. Account information is retained during the relationship and afterwards for applicable evidence and retention duties.

sections.title: 8. Checkout, payment, and Stripe
paragraphs: Stripe is used for checkout and payment processing. Stripe may process company, billing, payment, device, and transaction data. BCSentinel does not store complete card or bank-account details.
Processing supports contract formation, payment, fraud prevention, accounting, and compliance with legal obligations. The legal bases are Article 6(1)(b), (c), and (f) GDPR.

Payment and invoice records are retained according to applicable commercial and tax retention duties. Stripe may transfer information within its group and to technical providers under the privacy and transfer mechanisms identified by Stripe.

sections.title: 9. BCSentinel product use
paragraphs: Depending on use, we process tenant, environment, and company identifiers, user and contact data, licence and product status, scan and runtime metadata, check results, findings, exceptions, actions, aggregated metrics, dashboard and report data, and operational and security logs.

Processing supports registration, execution and protection of scans, delivery of product functions, access control, troubleshooting, support, and billing. Where data is processed for a customer, the data processing agreement, documented instructions, and agreed deletion periods apply.
BCSentinel does not automatically change customer data in Business Central. Business decisions and remediation remain with the customer.

sections.title: 10. Recipients and providers
items: Hetzner Online GmbH – hosting and technical infrastructure
Stripe – checkout, payment processing, and fraud prevention
FormSubmit – temporary forwarding of the contact form until technical replacement
Brevo – planned email delivery after migration to the first-party contact endpoint
Email, accounting, tax advisory, and support providers where required for the relevant purpose

sections.title: 11. International transfers
paragraphs: The described Hetzner hosting takes place in Germany. Depending on service structures, processing outside the European Economic Area cannot be completely excluded for Stripe, FormSubmit, and potentially Brevo. Such transfers take place only on the basis of an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards, particularly EU Standard Contractual Clauses, where required by law.

sections.title: 12. Retention periods
items: Server and security logs: generally up to 14 days, longer on a purpose-limited basis for incidents
General contact requests: generally up to six months after completion
Contract, payment, and invoice data: applicable statutory retention periods
Partner and user accounts: contract term plus required evidence, security, and retention periods
Product and customer data: according to contract, data processing agreement, and documented deletion concept

sections.title: 13. Data-subject rights
items: Withdrawal of consent with future effect
Complaint to a data-protection supervisory authority

sections.title: 14. Supervisory authority
paragraphs:
The State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information Rhineland-Palatinate
Hintere Bleiche 34
55116 Mainz
Germany
Data subjects may also contact any other competent supervisory authority.

sections.title: 15. Data security
paragraphs: We use appropriate technical and organisational measures, including HTTPS, server-side tenant and access checks, access restrictions, logging of security-relevant activity, and defined scan and token lifecycles. Security measures are developed in line with risk.

sections.title: 16. Automated decisions
paragraphs: No solely automated decision with legal or similarly significant effects within Article 22 GDPR takes place. Health Score, Estimated Loss, Potential Saving, and recommendations support decision-making and are not used as the sole basis for decisions about individuals.

sections.title: 17. Changes
paragraphs: This policy is updated when services, processing activities, providers, or legal requirements change. The current version is available on this website.
